segments.text: Are the kids okay?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The data shows that children ages 5 to 11 have a minuscule risk of COVID-19 hospitalization or death or long-haul COVID.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Safe prevention and treatment options are available for kids with COVID-19.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If treated early, children do not end up in the hospital.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But will our kids be okay if they take the COVID-19 vaccines?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Some will, some won't, and we don't know which.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Serious cardiac side effects from the Pfizer vaccines, including myocarditis, are rapidly rising in 16 to 24-year-olds.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Myocarditis has a mortality rate of 25-56% within 3-10 years, owing to progressive heart failure and cardiac arrest.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And families are on their own once that happens.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Pfizer has zero financial responsibility for any adverse effects from its COVID-19 vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Children already injured by the COVID vaccines have also been unable to get government aid.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We don't know how Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine will impact fertility and development.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No human reproductive toxicity data has been published to date.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We don't know why the Pfizer vaccine interferes with a child's healthy immune response and increases the risk of developing autoimmune disease.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We don't know because Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine trials for 5 to 11-year-olds tested the vaccine on fewer than 2,500 kids.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: and observe them for only two to eight weeks after vaccination.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Such underpowered trials would fail to detect many signals.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Vaccinating kids to protect adults when children themselves don't need the protection violates basic principles of ethics in medicine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Besides, vaccinated individuals already transmit the virus readily.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We can't possibly know what's going to happen with the medium to long-term effects of these vaccines on children.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The plan is to test the shots on our kids.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: During the FDA's review, they admitted this, that we can't know the vaccine's safety until after our kids take it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: What?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Dr. Eric Rubin, who sits on the FDA advisory panel that rushed through the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccines on children as young as five, was very clear about their ignorance on medium to long-term safety.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We're never going to learn about how safe this vaccine is unless we start giving it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's just the way it goes.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's not just the way it goes with our kids.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Join us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
